scope: Public documentation recheck for automatic builder-funded sponsorship combined with requested fixed refunds; no valid public bundles or funded tests.

providers.name: Titan
providers.notes: Shortfall trigger and positive builder balance required. Native blob shortfall funding, simultaneous refund, sponsored-source eligibility and gross-versus-net refund basis not established for this workload.

providers.name: Quasar
providers.notes: Do not infer transaction-value sponsorship from the gas-only wording. Aggregate payment must repay funding and any refund.

providers.name: BuilderNet
providers.notes: The July 8, 2026 community proposal is not an accepted or deployed API contract. Its sponsorship-netting discussion does not establish Titan or Quasar behavior.

interpretation: Not established means reviewed public documentation does not establish deployment/support. It is not proof a provider rejects the feature.

reviewed_combination_profiles.name: builder_funds_post_refund_selected_real_user
reviewed_combination_profiles.description: Candidate: combined user tips fund posting and a selected real user refund covers non-gas costs and margin. Verify actual funding and refund together; do not count the same reward twice.

reviewed_combination_profiles.name: builder_funds_high_tip_post_refund_post
reviewed_combination_profiles.description: Conditional candidate: use the sponsored post as the single refund source and pay a separate treasury. Needs sponsored-source eligibility, gross versus net formula, native blob affordability and recurring residual-balance validation.

reviewed_combination_profiles.name: operator_funds_post_refund_selected_real_user
reviewed_combination_profiles.description: Broad documented fallback: operator supplies capital before inclusion and selected external user refund must cover all operator-funded costs plus margin. This is not automatic builder sponsorship and does not collect every user tip.

remaining_checks: Builder-created funding and refund on the same actual native-blob workload
Gas and blob upfront affordability and cap funding
Refund source eligibility and sponsorship deductions
At least two consecutive included batches using residual poster balance
Exact target, successful canonical consumption, actual treasury payout and positive builder economics
Current Composer funding-prefix simulation/finalization integration before using an underfunded poster
existing_evidence_limits: The earlier 22-case local experiment manually supplied builder funding and refunds; it does not establish any provider combination.
coverage_note: No new market-share snapshot. Prior 2026-10-10 Titan/Quasar 73.59% sum is dated documentation-candidate coverage, not verified combined support.
